sentence: He spent his life mapping the four figures who live in every one of us.

sentence: The Persona is the mask you wear in public — the polished, acceptable, easy-to-be-around version of you.

sentence: The one who knows how to behave at work, at dinner, at the funeral.

sentence: You start believing the Persona is who you really are.

sentence: Jung said the entire journey of a life is this: to stop living as one of the four, and start living as all four, together, under one roof.
